title: "Cache buffers lost messages per topic" in ros2 bag record: slow disks, --max-cache-size 0, best-effort QoS and full disks, measured
excerpt: Why ros2 bag record drops messages after about 20 seconds: a disk slower than the topic, a cache of 0 that loses more and prints nothing, best-effort topics over UDP, and full disks. Lost counts, fixes and how to detect drops, measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
